purpose: Create a blind second-pass adjudication request set from hard judge-calibration rows so model-judge reliability can be measured before treating support metrics as paper-grade.

blind_protocol.instruction: Judge only from the compact evidence pack. Do not use outside paper knowledge. Return supported/partial/unsupported/correct_abstention/incorrect_abstention/invalid plus citation validity and a concise rationale.
blind_protocol.comparison_after_completion: Join second-pass verdicts back to the original adjudication packet by packet_id and policy, then report agreement by audit_type and disagreement examples.

required_completion_artifacts: second_pass_results.jsonl with one result per packet_id/case_id
agreement_report.md with original-vs-second-pass agreement by audit_type
updated manuscript/risk-audit treatment of model-judged metrics

llm_budget.note: This artifact only prepares blind requests and a budget estimate; it does not run the second-pass judge.
